paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the comparison of negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between the baseline MistralV0.2-Base and its variants fine-tuned on six different medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents the negative log-probability values, ranging approximately from -27 to -22, while the horizontal axis lists the specialty groups. Each subgroup features pairs of bars, with the light blue bar representing the baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the dark blue bars indicating the fine-tuned versions on each specialty. The baseline consistently shows the highest values in negative log-probability for all groups, highlighting weaker prediction capabilities. The Gastro-tuned variant stands out with the lowest negative log-probability across most specialty groups, indicating a strong positive adjustment in token predictions. The Infect group exhibits the largest overall bar heights, showing the most significant improvement from baseline to fine-tuned versions. The Cardio group displays the smallest spread between the baseline and fine-tuned variants, suggesting a lesser degree of improvement in predictive strength.
